request: Regular backorder: Sales can link an SO and SCM can link a PO at Confirmed, in either order.
specApproval: not obtained (autonomous run); implements the user's requested stage change
scenarios: A reviewed, accepted backorder permits Sales SO linkage before any PO exists.
SCM can link the PO before or after the SO, using the same reviewed/accepted material readiness.
SO linkage does not depend on missing, unassigned, cancelled, or active PO plans.
Unreviewed, pending, changed, or all-resolved-without-accepted materials cannot authorize a new link, including forged client readiness flags.
Role and yard access, terminal request protection, canonical order validation, revision conflicts, and audit events remain enforced.
Concurrent SO and PO saves from one revision allow one save; refreshing and retrying saves the other without losing either link.
The real Sales and SCM screens show their link forms at Confirmed and explain the same prerequisite before confirmation.
Special Item and stocking workflows, NetSuite write restrictions, and dispatch/completion stages retain their existing behavior.

failureModel.earlyOrForgedLinks: HTTP rejection and property tests use persisted material readiness
failureModel.lostConcurrentSave: parallel HTTP saves, revision and audit assertions, then retry
failureModel.frontendBackendMismatch: real Playwright browser plus shared predicate properties
failureModel.unrelatedDeploymentDrift: three-file patch over captured production source, exact image hashes and configuration verification

setup.git: Preserve the dirty workspace; no commits or reset.
setup.tests: Existing Node, fast-check, Playwright, c8, ESLint, and TypeScript in the standard isolated Compose stack; mbbs-tests.slice and existing bounds; teardown registered before startup.
setup.database: Disposable synthetic test database only; no production migration.
